# Snapshots API — operations

4 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `snapshots.create-snapshot-share-link` — **Create Snapshot Share Link** — `POST /snapshots/share/link` (write, agency)
  Create a share link for snapshot
- `snapshots.get-custom-snapshots` — **Get Snapshots** — `GET /snapshots/` (read, agency)
  Get a list of all own and imported Snapshots
- `snapshots.get-latest-snapshot-push` — **Get Last Snapshot Push** — `GET /snapshots/snapshot-status/{snapshotId}/location/{locationId}` (read, agency)
  Get Latest Snapshot Push Status for a location id
- `snapshots.get-snapshot-push` — **Get Snapshot Push between Dates** — `GET /snapshots/snapshot-status/{snapshotId}` (read, agency)
  Get list of sub-accounts snapshot pushed in time period
